<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-04-2304-02-58" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">slob dpon phywa ba</rs>s ni <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6173">ne'u thog</rs> gi gdan sa ma mdzad gong nas chos grwa mang du bskyangs shing | bstan bcos brtsams pa yang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6167">byams pa'i chos lnga</rs> dang | <rs type="work" ref="db:3774" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">tshad ma rnam par nges pa</rs> dang | <rs type="work" ref="db:5916" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dbu ma bden gnyis</rs>| <rs type="work" ref="db:3731" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">rgyan</rs>| <rs type="work" ref="db:3734" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">snang</rs> ga <rs type="work" ref="db:3727" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">spyod 'jug</rs> la sogs pa'i TI ka mang po yang mdzad | 
         so so'i bsdus pa yang mang du brtsams | <rs type="work" ref="db:4503" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">tshad ma'i bsdus pa yid kyi mun sel</rs> zhes bya ba tshigs su bcad pa rang 'grel dang bcas pa dang | yid kyi mun sel rkyang pa ste gnyis mdzad | 
         dbu ma la yang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6568">bsdus pa che</rs> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4486">chung gnyis</rs><note type="editorial">It is not clear whether (ID:4486) is the samll or the large summary</note> snang |
         gzhan yang rtsom pa mang po mdzad pa 'dra ste <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5839">kho bo</rs>s mthong ba ni de dag dang | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4505">phyi nang gi grub mtha' bsdus pa</rs> dang <rs type="work" ref="db:5971" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">shes bya gzhi lnga'i bshad pa</rs> tsam zhig go</seg></TEI>
